name: Permission Marketing MCP
description: Operationalizes Seth Godin's Permission Marketing framework to manage user trust and delegation in AI agent systems through a structured five-level permission ladder. It provides tools for requesting, auditing, and revoking permissions to enable autonomous agent actions within user-defined guardrails.
